_comment: Showcase generations pre-computed by `python -m worldmodels.cli warm-cache` on the GPU pod before the customer meeting. Replay mode serves them by id (worldmodels.showcase) and as nearest-prompt matches for live-typed what-if questions. condition: none = text2video, image = a frame (frame: first|middle|last, default middle for real clips) of source_clip (image2video), video = continue source_clip (video2video). source_clip: auto = first kept curated VIDEO clip, real process-camera clips (BAM tandem GMAW) before simulator clips; auto:<defect> = one with that defect first; append @<source_id> to prefer a dataset. Transfer source_pass: auto = first pass dir with control/<kind>.mp4 for every kind, real passes first (BAM: Canny edges of the real video). scene.source (set automatically from the picked clip / pass) switches the prompt wrapper to the real setup. The what-if ids/prompts mirror copilot/models.py CHANGE_TEMPLATES so live copilot requests replay as exact-prompt (or nearest-prompt) cache hits.

what_if.title: Baseline: tandem GMAW fill layer inside the nominal window (real BAM frame)
what_if.prompt: Steady tandem GMAW fill layer with two stable arcs feeding one weld pool, consistent ripple spacing and a smooth bead that wets evenly into both groove faces

what_if.title: What if travel speed drops 20%?
what_if.prompt: Robot travel speed is reduced by 20 percent. Heat input rises about 25 percent: the molten pool grows larger and hotter, the bead becomes wider and flatter with coarser ripples, and the glow trail behind the arc lengthens.

what_if.title: What if shielding gas flow collapses?
what_if.prompt: Shielding gas flow collapses from 21 to 5 litres per minute. The arc becomes erratic and flickers, spatter increases, the pool surface oxidises and gas pores appear in the trailing bead.

what_if.title: Porosity synthesis for detector training
what_if.prompt: Clusters of spherical gas pores (porosity) form in the solidifying weld bead behind the arc, with visible surface-breaking blowholes.

what_if.title: What if arc voltage runs 20% high?
what_if.prompt: Arc voltage increases by 20 percent: the arc lengthens and widens, and an undercut groove is melted into both toes of the bead without being filled.

what_if.title: What if interpass temperature exceeds the WPS maximum?
what_if.prompt: Interpass temperature exceeds the procedure maximum; a fine longitudinal centreline crack opens in the cooling bead.

what_if.title: Tandem SAW bead with porosity (AIMEN setup, text2video)
what_if.prompt: Two-wire tandem submerged arc welding head travels along a thick plate butt joint under a granular flux blanket; behind it the slag cap lifts off and a few surface pores are visible in the cooled bead

what_if.title: Continue the inspected clip for 5 more seconds
what_if.prompt: The robot continues the same weld pass with the same parameters, the positioner keeps rotating the pipe and the bead keeps growing along the joint

transfer.title: Photoreal colour from the edge map of a real BAM process-camera video
transfer.prompt: Photoreal colour footage of a robotic tandem GMAW fill layer in a deep V-groove of a thick steel plate: two bright arcs, one glowing weld pool and a grey solidified bead with fine ripples

transfer.title: Same real edge map, prompted with porosity (synthetic defect data)
transfer.prompt: Photoreal colour footage of a robotic tandem GMAW fill layer where gas pockets erupt through the weld pool and leave surface porosity in the bead
